warnings: Cast-in-place slab details. Each bar row is a bar_layers[] entry with the printed text; 'ตรง สลับคอม้า' = straight alternating with bent-up bars. Which top layer is 'ทางสั้น' on S1/S2 is not printed for one of the two top rows ('เสริมพิเศษ' alone); kept as printed.
S0 is the walkway slab around the building; its thickness is printed on A-12 (0.08), not on this sheet, so thickness_mm is left out here.
